title: Pukan
description: The ultimate performance based on VulkanMod
body:
## pukan is good
pukan is a lightweight, no-nonsense modpack designed to squeeze every drop of performance out of your game by leveraging the **vulkan api** instead of opengl. every mod has been hand-picked and verified compatible with vulkanmod — no crashes, no bloat, just pure speed. whether you're running a potato pc or a high-end rig, pukan will deliver buttery-smooth gameplay while keeping things clean and vanilla-friendly.

</details>

## what's inside

- core rendering:
**[vulkanmod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod)**,
**[badoptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)**.
- general performance:
**[lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)**,
**[ferritecore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)**,
**[krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton)**.
- world & chunk optimization:
**[c2me](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric)**.
- rendering & culling:
**[entity culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)**,
**[cull leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/cull-leaves)**.
- quality of life:
**[mod menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**,
**[betterf3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3)**.

## compatibility notes

- gpu must support **vulkan 1.2 or higher** (most modern gpus do).
- any additionals mods that hook deeply into the rendering pipeline may be incompatible.
